propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentOccurenceFiberSegment
propertySets.definition: Properties of fiber segment occurrences. This property set is applicable to occurrences of IfcCableSegment with predefined type FIBERSEGMENT.

properties.name: InUse
properties.definition: Indicates whether the fiber has been assigned to some specific use.

propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeFiberSegment
propertySets.definition: Properties of fiber segments. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type FIBERSEGMENT.

properties.name: FiberColour
properties.definition: Indicates the colour of a single fiber.

properties.name: HasTightJacket
properties.definition: Indicates whether the fiber has a tight jacket or not.

properties.name: FiberType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of the single fiber.
